analysis.headline: Shares Your Data with E-Comm
analysis.quote: For the purposes of purchasing Kaspersky products and services your data may be transferred to one of our e-comm providers.

analysis.headline: Shares with External Service Providers
analysis.quote: Processors: Service providers which we use for the provision of certain services e.g. vendors. As far as such external service providers need to have access to personal data, we ensure that any such access is limited to the extent necessary for the provision of the respective service.

analysis.headline: Shares with Public & Private Bodies
analysis.quote: Public bodies: Authorities and state institutions, such as public prosecutors’ offices, courts or tax authorities, to which we may have to transmit personal data in individual cases. Private bodies: Private bodies to which we transfer your personal data on the basis of a legal provision or your consent.

analysis.headline: Transfers Your Data Globally
analysis.quote: The personal data provided by users to Kaspersky can be processed in countries outside the European Union (EU) or the European Economic Area (EEA) and can include the following: United Kingdom, Switzerland, Canada, Singapore, Russia, Japan, USA, Mexico, China, Azerbaijan, Turkey, Brazil.

analysis.headline: Retains Account Data After Deletion
analysis.quote: Once your account has been deleted, your personal data will be held in Kaspersky's database until the retention period has expired, but you will no longer be able to access the Kaspersky CompanyAccount website using the deleted account.

analysis.headline: Administrator Can Access Your Account
analysis.quote: Your company's Kaspersky CompanyAccount Administrator will also be able to change your account settings and reset your password.

analysis.headline: Collects Detailed Device Information
analysis.quote: During your use of our websites or webservices we may process your IP address, network provider, browser type, visited domain names, and other information about your client environment (such as model of your device, operating system, screen resolution, etc.).

analysis.headline: Collects Sensitive Support Files
analysis.quote: Furthermore, it may be helpful or even necessary for this purpose to send us files you are experiencing problems with via the "Upload" function. These may also contain personal data, such as user specific or otherwise personally identifiable file names, meta data or contents.

analysis.headline: Uses Cookies, Blocking Breaks Site
analysis.quote: However, please be aware that the blocking of cookies may have the effect that you will not be able to use all our website functions any more.
